lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਪਤੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gupatee baanee paragat hoi ||
lines.translation: The hidden Bani of the Word is revealed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਰਖਿ ਲਏ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੫੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak parakh lae sach soi ||53||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True Lord is revealed and known. ||53||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj bhaai mileeai sukh hovai ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the Lord through intuition and love, peace is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਾਗੈ ਨੀਦ ਨ ਸੋਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh jaagai need na sovai ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh remains awake and aware; he does not fall sleep.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰਿ ਧਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)n sabad apara(n)par dhaarai ||
lines.translation: He enshrines the unlimited, absolute Shabad deep within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kahate mukat sabad nisataarai ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Shabad, he is liberated, and saves others as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦੀਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kee deekhiaa se sach raate ||
lines.translation: Those who practice the Guru's Teachings are attuned to the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਮਿਲਣ ਨਹੀ ਭ੍ਰਾਤੇ ॥੫੪॥
lines.transliteration: naanak aap gavaai milan nahee bhraate ||54||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who eradicate their self-conceit meet with the Lord; they do not remain separated by doubt. ||54||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਚਵਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਤੁ ਠਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kubudh chavaavai so kit thaai ||
lines.translation: "Where is that place, where evil thoughts are destroyed?

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਤਤੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu tat na boojhai chotaa khaai ||
lines.translation: The mortal does not understand the essence of reality; why must he suffer in pain?"

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਧੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jam dar baadhe koi na raakhai ||
lines.translation: No one can save one who is tied up at Death's door.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਪਤਿ ਸਾਖੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin sabadai naahee pat saakhai ||
lines.translation: Without the Shabad, no one has any credit or honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiu kar boojhai paavai paar ||
lines.translation: "How can one obtain understanding and cross over?"

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਨ ਬੁਝੈ ਗਵਾਰੁ ॥੫੫॥
lines.transliteration: naanak manamukh na bujhai gavaar ||55||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the foolish self-willed manmukh does not understand. ||55||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਮਿਟੈ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: kubudh mitai gurasabad beechaar ||
lines.translation: Evil thoughts are erased, contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur bhetai mokh duaar ||
lines.translation: Meeting with the True Guru, the door of liberation is found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੈ ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tat na cheenai manamukh jal jaai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh does not understand the essence of reality, and is burnt to ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਵਿਛੁੜਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: duramat vichhuR chotaa khaai ||
lines.translation: His evil-mindedness separates him from the Lord, and he suffers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਭੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: maanai hukam sabhe gun giaan ||
lines.translation: Accepting the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he is blessed with all virtues and spiritual wisdom.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥੫੬॥
lines.transliteration: naanak daragah paavai maan ||56||
lines.translation: O Nanak, he is honored in the Court of the Lord. ||56||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਚੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saach vakhar dhan palai hoi ||
lines.translation: One who possesses the merchandise, the wealth of the True Name,

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਤਰੈ ਤਾਰੇ ਭੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap tarai taare bhee soi ||
lines.translation: crosses over, and carries others across with him as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਰਤਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sahaj rataa boojhai pat hoi ||
lines.translation: One who intuitively understands, and is attuned to the Lord, is honored.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: taa kee keemat karai na koi ||
lines.translation: No one can estimate his worth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jah dekhaa tah rahiaa samaai ||
lines.translation: Wherever I look, I see the Lord permeating and pervading.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੈ ਸਚ ਭਾਇ ॥੫੭॥
lines.transliteration: naanak paar parai sach bhaai ||57||
lines.translation: O Nanak, through the Love of the True Lord, one crosses over. ||57||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਾ ਕਹਾ ਵਾਸੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਜਿਤੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: s sabad kaa kahaa vaas katheeale jit tareeai bhavajal sa(n)saaro ||
lines.translation: "Where is the Shabad said to dwell? What will carry us across the terrifying world-ocean?

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਤ ਅੰਗੁਲ ਵਾਈ ਕਹੀਐ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਹੁ ਕਵਨੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai sat a(n)gul vaaee kaheeai tis kahu kavan adhaaro ||
lines.translation: The breath, when exhaled, extends out ten finger lengths; what is the support of the breath?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੋਲੈ ਖੇਲੈ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: bolai khelai asathir hovai kiu kar alakh lakhaae ||
lines.translation: Speaking and playing, how can one be stable and steady? How can the unseen be seen?"

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਅਪਣੇ ਮਨ ਸਮਝਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun suaamee sach naanak pranavai apane man samajhaae ||
lines.translation: Listen, O master; Nanak prays truly. Instruct your own mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sabade sach liv laagai kar nadaree mel milaae ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh is lovingly attuned to the True Shabad. Bestowing His Glance of Grace, He unites us in His Union.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੫੮॥
lines.transliteration: aape daanaa aape beenaa poorai bhaag samaae ||58||
lines.translation: He Himself is all-knowing and all-seeing. By perfect destiny, we merge in Him. ||58||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁ ਸਬਦ ਕਉ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਅਲਖੰ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: s sabad kau nira(n)tar vaas alakha(n) jah dekhaa tah soee ||
lines.translation: That Shabad dwells deep within the nucleus of all beings. God is invisible; wherever I look, there I see Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਵਨ ਕਾ ਵਾਸਾ ਸੁੰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ਅਕਲ ਕਲਾ ਧਰ ਸੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: pavan kaa vaasaa su(n)n nivaasaa akal kalaa dhar soee ||
lines.translation: The air is the dwelling place of the absolute Lord. He has no qualities; He has all qualities.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: nadar kare sabad ghat mahi vasai vichahu bharam gavaae ||
lines.translation: When He bestows His Glance of Grace, the Shabad comes to abide within the heart, and doubt is eradicated from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮੋੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: tan man niramal niramal baanee naamou ma(n)n vasaae ||
lines.translation: The body and mind become immaculate, through the Immaculate Word of His Bani. Let His Name be enshrined in your mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਭਵਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰੀਐ ਇਤ ਉਤ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabad guroo bhavasaagar tareeai it ut eko jaanai ||
lines.translation: The Shabad is the Guru, to carry you across the terrifying world-ocean. Know the One Lord alone, here and hereafter.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਿਹਨੁ ਵਰਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੫੯॥
lines.transliteration: chihan varan nahee chhaaiaa maaiaa naanak sabad pachhaanai ||59||
lines.translation: He has no form or color, shadow or illusion; O Nanak, realize the Shabad. ||59||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਸਤ ਅੰਗੁਲ ਵਾਈ ਅਉਧੂ ਸੁੰਨ ਸਚੁ ਆਹਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai sat a(n)gul vaaee audhoo su(n)n sach aahaaro ||
lines.translation: O reclusive hermit, the True, Absolute Lord is the support of the exhaled breath, which extends out ten finger lengths.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਤਤੁ ਬਿਰੋਲੈ ਚੀਨੈ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh bolai tat birolai cheenai alakh apaaro ||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh speaks and churns the essence of reality, and realizes the unseen, infinite Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮੇਟੈ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਸਾਏ ਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਚੂਕੈ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai gun metai sabad vasaae taa man chookai aha(n)kaaro ||
lines.translation: Eradicating the three qualities, he enshrines the Shabad within, and then, his mind is rid of egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar baahar eko jaanai taa har naam lagai piaaro ||
lines.translation: Inside and out, he knows the One Lord alone; he is in love with the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਮਨਾ ਇੜਾ ਪਿੰਗੁਲਾ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਅਲਖੁ ਲਖਾਏ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhamanaa iRaa pi(n)gulaa boojhai jaa aape alakh lakhaae ||
lines.translation: He understands the Sushmana, Ida and Pingala, when the unseen Lord reveals Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਹੁ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੬੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tihu te oopar saachaa satigur sabad samaae ||60||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the True Lord is above these three energy channels. Through the Word, the Shabad of the True Guru, one merges with Him. ||60||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਥੀਅਲੇ ਪਵਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kaa jeeu pavan katheeale pavan kahaa ras khaaee ||
lines.translation: "The air is said to be the soul of the mind. But what does the air feed on?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਮੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਕਵਨ ਅਉਧੂ ਸਿਧ ਕੀ ਕਵਨ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: giaan kee mudraa kavan audhoo sidh kee kavan kamaaee ||
lines.translation: What is the way of the spiritual teacher, and the reclusive hermit? What is the occupation of the Siddha?"
